# odinex_server_types (Data Source)

Lists all server types.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "odinex_server_types" "all" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `ids` (List of String) IDs of all server types.
- `names` (List of String) Names of all server types.
- `server_types` (List of Object) All server types. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--server_types))

<a id="nestedatt--server_types"></a>
### Nested Schema for `server_types`

Read-Only:

- `cores` (Number)
- `cpu_type` (String)
- `deprecated` (Boolean)
- `description` (String)
- `disk` (Number)
- `id` (Number)
- `included_traffic` (Number)
- `memory` (Number)
- `name` (String)
- `prices` (List of Object) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedobjatt--server_types--prices))

<a id="nestedobjatt--server_types--prices"></a>
### Nested Schema for `server_types.prices`

Read-Only:

- `location` (String)
- `price_hourly_gross` (String)
- `price_hourly_net` (String)
- `price_monthly_gross` (String)
- `price_monthly_net` (String)
